subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu support an inbound attachment-content opt-out, and should it honor the reported `ignoreFileContent` key or introduce a canonical OpenClaw media policy name instead?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the current key is not documented or implemented and OpenClaw's config-surface policy requires maintainer intent before adding or preserving a config knob.

options.title: Add a canonical opt-out
options.body: Implement a documented Feishu media-content opt-out, optionally migrating or warning on `ignoreFileContent`, with tests and live proof.

options.title: Honor the legacy key directly
options.body: Treat `ignoreFileContent` as the supported Feishu account/channel key, but accept the extra compatibility surface and document it.

options.title: Reject the key with diagnostics
options.body: Do not add an opt-out yet; instead make doctor/config docs explain that `ignoreFileContent` is unsupported and recommend existing media limits.

recommendation.title: Add a canonical opt-out
recommendation.body: Implement a documented Feishu media-content opt-out, optionally migrating or warning on `ignoreFileContent`, with tests and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is Feishu-plugin-owned and @m1heng is the strongest owner signal in package metadata and feature history.
